items.title: Moderna Is Yesterday's Top Gainer and Today's Biggest Loser
items.summary: Moderna was the best performing stock in the S&P 500 yesterday.  Moderna stock had fallen over 22% on Thursday in its worst single-day decline on record, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  The stock more than doubled in the trading session prior.

items.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Dumped Micron, Intel, and Broadcom: Here Are the AI Infrastructure Stocks He Bought Instead
items.summary: Stanley Druckenmiller just closed out three of the most talked-about semiconductor positions on Wall Street and immediately put the proceeds to work in a pair of AI infrastructure names most income investors overlook entirely.

items.title: Intel (INTC) Stock Became 67% Of A Major Investor’s US Equity Portfolio
items.summary: SoftBank Group has made Intel (NasdaqGS: INTC) the centerpiece of its latest 13F filing, with the stock accounting for nearly 67% of the group’s disclosed U.S. equity portfolio. The position reflects an unusually high single stock concentration for SoftBank and gives Intel a visible role in the group’s U.S. equity approach. The move adds fresh context to Intel’s AI and manufacturing build out, aligning its recent capital raises and executive changes with support from a major global...

items.title: NVIDIA Looks Expensive Until You Ask What Has To Ship
items.summary: Consensus turns today's multiple into a much lower one within two years, and by management's own account the constraint on getting there is capacity rather than demand.

items.title: Micron's Biggest Risk Is Written In Its Construction Budget
items.summary: Micron is spending record cash flow on new fabs whose output arrives into the same year its own outlook expects memory supply to improve.

items.title: Tiger Global Added to Its Position in Intel in Q2
items.summary: Tiger Global substantially increased its Intel stake during Q2, adding another institutional vote of confidence as Intel's AI, data center, and foundry businesses gain momentum.

items.title: The Upside Case For Qualcomm Stock Now Carries Purchase Orders
items.summary: Qualcomm's non-handset business is inflecting fast enough that management expects it to replace the revenue Apple is taking away, and the first proof of that arrives in the December quarter.

items.title: Broadcom Holds Steady as ARK Buys the Dip, Intel Slips, AMD Eases After Google’s Marvell Chip Deal
items.summary: Google just handed Marvell a $12.2 billion equity-linked custom-chip deal, and Broadcom shareholders are left wondering how much of their AI revenue story walked out the door with it.
